title: 鉄拳の咆哮 ―剥き出しの鼓動―
author: 鉄 ハガネ

en.title: Roar of the Iron Fist: Bare Heartbeat
en.premise: Once hailed as a genius, I abandoned my fists after a certain incident. Now, I find myself standing once again before a rusted punching bag. Before me stands a boy cursed with the inability to lie; whenever his emotions flare and his face flushes, the trajectory of the strike he must deliver becomes visible to me. Amidst a wasteland of silence, trusting only in the weight of a single blow, we step into the desert they call the ring.

zh.title: 铁拳的咆哮 ―赤裸的悸动―
zh.premise: 曾被誉为天才，却因某起事件而放弃拳头的人是我，此刻我正站在一个生锈的沙袋前。在我面前，是一个拥有“无法撒谎”之诅咒的少年。每当他的情绪波动、脸颊泛红时，应当出拳的轨迹便会清晰可见。在如荒野般的寂静中，我们仅凭对一击之重的信任，踏入了名为“擂台”的沙漠之中。
